company.shortDescription: SuperApp makes AI multiplayer - natively. Your whole team and the leading AI models think, debate, and create together in one live thread.
company.description: AI was single-player. SuperApp makes it multiplayer - natively. Your whole team and the leading AI models think, debate, and create together in one live thread.SuperApp brings your team and leading AI models from multiple providers into one live conversation. People and AI can think together, challenge ideas, build on one another’s work, and turn the conversation into a document, presentation, spreadsheet, or interactive application -- without leaving behind the shared context where the work began.
